references.text: David encourages exalting the Lord's name together, reflecting the praise of God's name in Deuteronomy 32:3.
The call to give the Lord glory for the splendor of his name corresponds with giving greatness to our God.
Giving the Lord the honor due to his name reflects the theme of proclaiming the Lord's name and giving God greatness.
Praising God's great and awesome name connects with the proclamation of the Lord's name.
Exalting God as king and blessing his name reflects the theme of proclaiming the Lord's name.
Offering sacrifices of praise to God, that is, the fruit of lips that confess his name, reflects the proclamation of God's name in Deuteronomy.
The Lord is great and worthy of all praise, which corresponds with giving greatness to our God.
The Lord comes down and proclaims his own name, which connects with the proclamation of the Lord's name.
